name: ascribed_family_and_acquired_social_subgroups_v1
description: A complete, mutually exclusive refinement of the ascribed-family versus remaining-social-ties audit. inherited preserves the original ascribed-family definition. The five primary acquired groups are intimate_partnership, education_mentorship, professional_collaboration, influence_succession, and religious_ordination. other_acquired is an explicit residual bucket for low-support or semantically heterogeneous acquired labels; it is retained for completeness but is not in the default period matrix. Groups describe Wikidata relation labels, not causal mechanisms or voluntary choices.
